title: Predication fiber algebra A_p = (L x L)^(E x E)
description: The value fiber at a predicate p: the set of functions from entity-pairs E x E to bilattice values L x L, i.e. the (E x E)-fold pointwise power of the bilattice B = L|><|L. It is itself a bilattice under pointwise operations, so the rich residuated-bilattice structure (knowledge/truth orders, negation, twist fusion/residual) lifts componentwise. Carrier B^(E x E) is exponential in |E|^2 -- represented structurally by the base bilattice B and the index E x E, never enumerated, and never a fixed finite truth-set.

index.description: The E x E index: ordered entity-pairs (subject, object) over which the fiber assigns bilattice values.
